title: Pisgah
html_source:
Pisgah in Hebrew means “summit” or “peak”. In translation, pisgah lost its meaning and became a mountain’s proper name instead of being a term describing a mountaintop.

Mount Pisgah (Bible)
Some translators of the biblical book of Deuteronomy translate Pisgah (פִּסְגָּה) as a name of a mountain, usually referring to Mount Nebo. The region is directly east of the Jordan River and just northeast of the Dead Sea.
